# Inherited arrangement changes further copying

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

For every alphabet with decidable equality and every law of draws: a copy of a word produces the word exactly when the pool holds each token at least as often as the word uses it and the free support covers what its attachments draw; with a release, exactly when the support also covers it; copies drawn in turn from one shared pool are all released exactly when the pool supplies all the words together and the support covers all their draws and releases, whatever their order, and for n copies of one word exactly when the pool and support hold n times what one released copy needs. Under local draws a word's use depends on the law only through its length and unlike adjacent pairs: among words of one length, the one with more unlike pairs draws less exactly when an unlike attachment draws less than a like one, and uses are in arithmetic progression where unlike pairs are. The structural copy machine is an instance: a template strand is copied and released exactly when the pool supplies its tokens and the support covers its draws plus one, for every pool; the old theorem of the support needed, the alternating/clustered ranking and the third-arrangement constraint are instances; a lineage of n from a path strand is released at every reproduction exactly when the support used grows by n times the draws and release, the converse of the every-finite-lineage theorem, which fails on the strands alone. An actual exchange changes retained order and tokenwise material copying transmits it.

Canonical source: [StructuralCopying.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/StructuralCopying.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- A nonempty path template admits ordered exact access; equal/unequal adjacency costs, exchange, release and occurrence order are supplied.
- The general sufficiency/necessity theorem uses the template sequence plus a residual tail as stock; attachment consumes material, with one support unit each for first attachment and release.

The previous actual ABAB fragment meets the new structural template input; this checks the endpoint without deriving reading capability from old attachment. Operational roles differentiate through retained order, token transfers and release.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

34 new theorem declarations / 57 new audits, with 373 inherited declarations separate in 430 actual-closure audits. The primary paper supplies mechanism/comparison context, not a new data reanalysis. General laws: checker receipts bound.

Reading/fidelity capability, physicochemical costs, mutation occurrence, autonomous feed and population invasion are not derived. The third-cost constraint exceeds independently fitted coefficients but is also available to a strong conventional model with the same mechanism.

- Shared-stock order can release the more costly arrangement first; a complete copy need not be released, and changed local costs can reverse ranking. [StructuralCopying.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/StructuralCopying.lean)
- strands_do_not_show_release: with support for the copy but not for its release, a lineage of one holds two copies of the parent while its reproduction is not released, so read on the strands alone the converse of the finite-lineage theorem fails. [CopyingInstances.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/CopyingInstances.lean)
